{{Top|leg}}
A '''comm scanner''',<ref name="R">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref> '''communications scanner''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> or '''communication signal scanner'''<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> was a piece of communications equipment that monitored frequencies, such as emergency channels,<ref name="R" /> and could detect unauthorized [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transmissions.<ref name="EGWT" /> They were used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] to monitor situations such as fatal accidents.<ref name="R" /> Comm scanners had difficulty detecting transmissions from [[PTP link]]s due to the low power it used and the fact that the technology was antiquated by modern standards.<ref name="GFT" />
